message.content:
The Declaration of Independence was signed by 56 delegates representing the thirteen American colonies. The signers were:

1. John Hancock – Massachusetts  
2. Samuel Adams – Massachusetts  
3. John Adams – Massachusetts  
4. Joseph Warren – Massachusetts  
5. William Dawes – Massachusetts  
6. Paul Revere – Massachusetts  
7. John Hancock – Massachusetts (again)  
8. John Hancock – Massachusetts (again)  

(These are just a few; the full list includes representatives from each colony such as George Washington, Thomas Jefferson, Benjamin Franklin, John Jay, and many others.)

The question is about the Declaration of Independence of the United States. The signers were 56 delegates from the thirteen colonies. We should give the names.
